_doc: Granny Haymaker coach lines (docs/design/ANNOUNCER_AND_TUTORIAL.md §2). trigger 'tutorial' with when.exercise (1-10) and when.phase (intro | success | hint); fighter jabs use when.creature; {juice} = the fighter's JUICE name; {ability1} = the fighter's first ability name. mood 'pleased' adds her warble.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Stick moves you. Camera does the thinking. Walk to the rings. Then circle the Kid. He's harmless. Today.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Good. Feet first. Everything you'll ever do starts with where you're standing.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: You're facing him automatically. That's the lock-on. You just move; it does the looking.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Light button. Three taps, three hits. Jab, cross, hook, or whatever your body calls them. Don't think. Tap.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: That's a string. It'll work on a lot of people. Not on the good ones. We'll fix that.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Tap it three times in a row. Don't hold it. The third hit's the one with the shove.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Heavy button. Slower, hurts more, shrugs off little hits. Now hold it. Feel that? That's a charge. Let it go.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: That's the one that ends arguments. It's also the one you'll miss most. Don't fall in love with it.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Hold the Heavy button until your fighter's whole body winds up. Then let go near him.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Guard. Hold it. He's gonna throw three. You'll take a little, not a lot. Guard costs stamina, so don't live there.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Hands up, chin down, everything else is details.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Hold Guard before his hands start moving and keep it held. Let go after the third.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Dodge plus a direction. Quick, and nothing touches you. Now press Light while you're dodging. That's a dash attack.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Nothing hits what isn't there. And when you come back, come back swinging.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Wait for his big wind-up, then dodge sideways. For the dash attack, press Light while you're still sliding.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Left bumper. That's yours. Every critter's got two tricks; that's the first. Use it, watch the ring, use it again.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: That's what makes you you. Everything else, everyone's got.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Press LB when he's in front of you. Watch the little ring on the HUD. When it's full, it's ready.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: He's guarding. Guard beats hands. Grab beats guard. Grab, then push a direction to throw him. Toward the wall if you're mean.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Strikes beat grabs. Grabs beat guard. Guard beats strikes. There's your triangle. Everything in this cage is three things.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Walk right up to him while his guard's up, press Grab, then push the stick toward the wall.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Here's the next layer. Guard, but late, right as it lands. That's a parry. Watch his shoulder. The shoulder never lies.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: That's a read. Do that to the Commissioner and I'll put your picture up myself.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Don't hold Guard. Tap it the instant his hand reaches you. Early is a block. Late is a bruise. The window's small.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Two lights, then Heavy in the middle of the string. That's your finisher. Full meter, right trigger. That's the JUICE.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Yours is called {juice}. Don't ask what's in it.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: That's the whole kit. Hands, heavy, guard, dodge, grab, two tricks, and the JUICE. Everything after this is timing.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Light, Light, then Heavy quickly. For the JUICE: fill the meter, taunt with D-pad Up when he's far, then hold the right trigger.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Alright. He's gonna fight back now. Sixty seconds. Use whatever you learned. Use whatever you didn't. Go.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Hm. Fine. Granny's corner is always open. Go lose to someone better and come tell me about it.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Guard when he winds up. Hit him when he's done. Three things, kid.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Try not to set the mats on fire this time.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Both claws, Dredge. I know the small one's shy.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Less hair, more hitting.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Turn. Turning is a thing. We'll work on it.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: No puddles in my gym. Fine. One puddle.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Breathe. You don't breathe. Do the thing that's like breathing.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: You lost to a dog? Fine. Dogs are fast. Show me your guard.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Hands up. Chin down. Everything else is details.

items.speaker: granny
items.text: Hit the bag like it owes you Scrip.
